attchmntText: MMTC Limited has informed the Exchange about Change in Company Secretary/Compliance Officer
voiceSummary: MMTC Limited intimates the change in its Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. Shri Ajay Kumar Misra ceased to hold the position effective 10.11.2026 due to succession planning. The Board of Directors approved the appointment of Ms. Rashmi Chaddha as the new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective 10.11.2026. Ms. Chaddha is an Associate Member of The Institute of Company Secretaries of India with Membership Number A82319. She currently serves as Senior Manager Finance at MMTC Limited. She holds a Bachelor in Commerce Honours degree and has over 17 years of experience in finance and accounts. She is also a member of The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: MMTC Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: MMTC Limited announced the Board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 10th November 2026. The independent auditor issued a qualified conclusion on the standalone results. The qualification relates to the Anglo Coal matter. The company estimates a remaining liability of Rs. 170.58 crore. A provision of Rs. 87.76 crore is recorded. The remaining Rs. 82.82 crore is treated as a contingent liability. The auditor noted a departure from Indian Accounting Standard 37. The Audit Committee could not review the results due to non-appointment of Independent Directors. The Board approved the statement without Audit Committee review. The company reported a profit before tax of Rs. 10.96 crore for the quarter ended 30th September 2026.
